name: Spanx
what: Shapewear, leggings, apparel and intimates brand founded by Sara Blakely. Blackstone took a majority stake in 2021; Blakely remains executive chairwoman. Sold through own e-commerce, department stores and retail partners.
source_note: Blackstone buys majority stake in shapewear maker Spanx, valuing it at $1.2 billion

name: Kind Snacks
what: Snack bar, granola and nut-based snack brand; wholly owned by Mars (not a standalone listed company) and still sold under the Kind brand. Mars took full ownership in 2020 after buying a minority stake in 2017.
source_note: Mars deal to move from minority stake to full ownership 'worth $5 billion', announced November 2020

name: Kylie Cosmetics
what: Cosmetics brand founded by Kylie Jenner (lip kits, eyeshadow, blush, brushes). Coty owns 51%, Jenner 44.1%; sold direct online and via retailers.
last_round: 51% stake sold to Coty for USD 600M, 2019-11
source_note: Coty bought 51% for $600 million, valuing the company at about $1.2 billion (Nov 2019)

name: Casamigos
what: Premium tequila brand co-founded by George Clooney and Rande Gerber; owned by Diageo since 2017 and still sold under its own brand worldwide.
last_round: Acquired by Diageo, USD 700M upfront plus up to USD 300M earn-out, 2017-06
source_note: USD 700 million plus up to another USD 300 million tied to performance (June 2017)

name: Japan Wellbeing Corp
what: One of Japan's largest integrated home-care providers (day care, short-stay care, group homes, in-home nursing): 1,100+ care locations and about 110,000 users per month. Sold by MBK Partners to Advent International in 2026.
last_round: Buyout by Advent International from MBK Partners, 2026-06 (price undisclosed officially)
source_note: Advent release: terms not disclosed; Axios/Sahm Capital reported about USD 1.24B (about JPY 200B) incl. debt
